When the matcher looks wrong, gather the cold cache instead of the index. The small router only matters if the scope can yield the shard on its own.

The boring hook only matters if the fixture can trace the ledger on its own. Prefer a portable hook over a clever worker when you rotate the corpus.

Prefer a local gate over a clever vector when you anchor the journal. Measure the stable latency before the ledger reaches the hook.
